system.description:
You whip your weapon before channeling so much chakra into the end it looks like a blue moon at the end of your weapon. Make 2 melee Taijutsu attacks against a creature in range dealing your [Weapons damage] + 1d10. If both attacks are successful, you can make a third attack dealing 3d10 damage of your weapons type.

Chain 2: You shift your momentum. Until the end of your next turn, you can use any Chain effect on the next Bukijutsu you cast with a Flail weapon. You maintain the Chain rank used.

At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost by 3, and the third attacks damage by 1d10.
